text:
Iris (Growth): quick heads-up 1 22 weekly KPI snapshot: launch post CTR is steady but paid MQLs dropped ~21% vs prior period, and webinar registrants from paid are lower too. dropping here to triage before Friday email. :eyes:
Ben (Analytics): looking. two signals: (1) a jump in 'unknown_campaign' conversions starting ~09:30 PT, (2) GA4 shows a sampling warning on the daily report for the paid cohort. could be multi-factor.
Nikhil (MarOps): we rolled a mapping rule for partner channels last Wed but only for the syndication pipeline. didn't touch paid tags.
Zoe (Product Marketing): organic headline A/B ran yesterday only. paid creatives unchanged per registry.
Ben (Analytics): small check I ran to see where conversions are landing:
```
SELECT coalesce(campaign,'(unknown)') campaign, count(*) convs
FROM conversions
WHERE event_date >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY convs DESC
LIMIT 12;
```
Ben (Analytics): results show a cluster of conversions with referer host adrelay.cacheprox.com and campaign = NULL. that vendor had a redirect shim test per their status page.
Nikhil (MarOps): that matches my outbound convo with CacheProx (CP-314). they toggled a header rewrite experiment on 2026-07-08 for 5% of traffic.
Iris (Growth): ok — attribution loss + GA4 sampling could explain undercount. For Friday KPI we need a defensible number. Can BI add a pragmatic fallback and flag sample-affected cohorts?
Ben (Analytics): yes. I'll add two things to the ETL: (a) heuristic_campaign: utm_campaign -> last-session campaign -> referer-domain mapping; (b) sample_flag: mark rows from sessions where GA4 sampling likely impacted aggregate. Will push to BI and update the Launch Overview viz. ETA ~45m.
Zoe (Product Marketing): good. also can we add a sanity metric to the dashboard: percent of conversions with campaign null by referer host over last 7 days? quick signal for next time.
Ben (Analytics): yup I'll add that small tile.
dash-bot: dashboard "launch_overview_v3" updated by Ben. https://bi.redwood/d/launch_overview_v3
Nikhil (MarOps): operationally I'll escalate CP-314 and ask for immediate rollback for production clickpaths. also adding a server-side registration token to the backlog (hidden_campaign_server) so future reg captures don't rely on client query strings.
Iris (Growth): owners: Nikhil -> vendor rollback + backlog; Ben -> ETL heuristic + sample flag + dashboard tiles; Zoe -> confirm paid creative unchanged in registry; Iris -> re-run WoW and finalize Friday KPI email with a short caveat.
Ben (Analytics): posting interim adjusted numbers in ~50m. I'll include both raw and heuristic-attributed numbers so leadership can see delta.
Iris (Growth): thanks all :thumbsup: -- let's call out the attribution caveat in the KPI email: "Numbers may adjust as attribution cleanup completes; see dashboard tiles for raw vs heuristic views."
__note: Single Slack thread string. Short messages, SQL snippet, deploy-bot link, emoji, owners assigned. No title per agents.md.
